{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any rows with revenue that are suspiciously high
# Since '999999.99' is not present, look for any other anomalies
# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check max revenue to see if any are implausibly high
print("Max revenue (in float):", df['revenue_float'].max())
print("Rows with revenue > 10000:")
print(df[df['revenue_float'] > 10000])"}
